user_constraint: Settle the proposal first; do not expand training jobs to search for an idea.
objective: Find a feasible, substantively novel VLA training direction using existing demonstrations, motivated by unstable closed-loop finetuning gains.
decision: Retain feedback change as a falsifiable mechanism question. Do not endorse selective Jacobian preservation as an established novel algorithm.

new_evidence.level: Analytic diagnostic only, not VLA empirical evidence.
findings: Under exact fitting on a smooth demonstration manifold, full versus normal-direction derivative penalties differ by a constant over the feasible set.
An identical policy-derivative change can improve or worsen contraction depending on the environment dynamics.

mechanism_hypothesis: Some finetuning updates improve demonstrated actions but degrade responses to physically feasible nearby disturbances. This response change may help predict independent closed-loop gains.
current_evidence_limit: Neither aggregate damaging finetuning effects nor feedback damage has been established in the existing small panels.

stage_one.purpose: Test the mechanism before choosing or training a new method.

state_bank.target: 6 tasks, 5 distinct instances per task, one eligible snapshot per instance
state_bank.provenance: Fresh simulator snapshots, balanced between parent and finetuned rollouts. Existing observation caches are not complete simulator snapshots.
state_bank.selection: Use task and phase eligibility rules fixed before comparing outcomes; retain provenance and excluded-state counts.
state_bank.selection_limit: This bank estimates effects at its chosen phases and sources, not the entire deployment state distribution.
state_bank.initial_scope: Free approach states with an unheld movable task object. Post-contact and held-object states require a separate restoration validation and extension.

interventions.definition: Nominal plus positive/negative disturbances along three task-valid physical coordinates. Fix magnitudes before examining policy outcomes and record physical units.
restrictions: Re-render observations from physical states; do not treat image edits as physical interventions.
Reject penetrating, unreachable, invalid-goal or broken-constraint states by policy-independent rules.
Use the same settle and controller initialization procedure in nominal and disturbed branches.

stage_one.interpretation_of_bound: Design ceiling for the initial comparison, excluding snapshot construction and restoration checks; no job is authorized by this file alone or submitted here.

outcomes: Predeclared task-specific physical milestone reached within the horizon.
Existing task score change, reported even when insensitive over this horizon.
Object drop, undesired contact or loss of a previously achieved milestone where applicable.
feedback_measurement.paired_effect: For each policy, report disturbed minus nominal outcome; compare this disturbance effect between policies, alongside all absolute outcomes.
not_sufficient: Policy Jacobian magnitude or distance alone.
A large closed-loop advantage over open-loop action replay alone.
Returning to an expert trajectory when alternate successful paths exist.

controls: Validate restore-and-repeat parity before policy comparisons, including controller, task, grasp, policy/history/cache and RNG state.
Preserve native deployment timing, action transforms and chunk execution length.
Use native subtask generation as the deployment condition. Fixed subtask labels may be a separate motor diagnostic, not the reported autonomous result.
Measure parent and finetuned action fitting on independent existing expert observations; do not infer broad fit improvement from three training-seen examples.

Where exact replay parity holds, replay nominal executed actions from the disturbed state to help distinguish passive trajectory tolerance from active response. Report replay and reactive outcomes separately.
Do not select states because one policy subsequently fails.

analysis.unit: Instance nested within task, not frames or perturbation branches.
analysis.report: Paired effects and uncertainty, task-level results, nominal outcomes, branch failures and sensitivity to physical perturbation magnitude.
analysis.claim_limit: A policy-by-disturbance interaction identifies different sensitivity to the assigned disturbances. It does not by itself establish mediation of the historical whole-task finetuning gap.
analysis.prediction_limit: Two checkpoints and six tasks cannot establish a general predictor of finetuning gains. A separate multi-checkpoint and multi-training-seed confirmation is required.

stage_two_conditional.entry: Replicated physical response changes that are not explained by nominal fit, state provenance, restoration errors or language-stage changes.
stage_two_conditional.candidate: Preserve validated useful pretrained responses while adapting demonstrated task behavior.
mandatory_controls: RETAIN with a tuned interpolation coefficient
SFT with tuned all-direction derivative/response matching
The proposed physically justified selective preservation rule
fairness: Same demonstrations, initialization family, optimizer budget and hyperparameter selection budget.
Compare task-fit versus closed-loop performance tradeoff curves, not one selected regularization coefficient.
Hold out evaluation instances and perturbation choices from rule construction and tuning.
Use multiple independent training seeds and an independent VLA implementation before broad claims.
stage_two_conditional.unresolved_method_requirement: A reliable selection rule must be justified; demonstration covariance alone is not causal identifiability, and useful-parent-response labels cannot be assumed from derivatives.

abandonment_conditions: Independent measurements do not reproduce fitting improvement together with degraded physical feedback in a meaningful subset of finetuning updates.
Feedback measurements add no predictive information about held-out closed-loop gains beyond nominal fit and simple adaptation baselines.
Full response matching or RETAIN achieves the same performance tradeoff; in this case do not claim a new selective training paradigm.
The selection rule needs human correction data at a scale incompatible with the user's constraint.

resources.h200_plan: Reserve broad multi-seed and cross-model training for after the mechanism and method novelty gates; accelerator availability does not establish the hypothesis.
